Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed alignment plan so we stay in sync. I kept this intentionally concise.

Key pain points you emphasized:
- Production latency spikes on peak hours (95th percentile ~ 320ms today) that are degrading chat UX.
- Per-token inference cost unpredictability across your inference fleet.
- Data governance: need VPC isolation and customer-managed key options for PHI-sensitive flows.

Stated goals (what success looks like):
- Reduce inference 95th latency to <= 150ms for common prompts.
- Reduce per-token inference cost ~30–40% via batching + quantization strategy.
- Deploy in a private VPC with KMS-managed keys and audit logs.

Proposed alignment (high-level runbook):
1) Pilot scoping & kickoff (technical deep-dive) — target week of Apr 12. Owner: Michael Grant (Redwood) / Olivia Harper (BrightPeak).
2) Security & compliance review (SOC2 evidence + retention plan) — target by Apr 19. Owner: Monica Patel (Redwood CS) / BrightPeak security contact.
3) Pilot execution (dedicated capacity for 2 weeks) — Apr 26–May 9. Deliverables: latency/cost baselines, model-config recommendations.
4) Exec review & procurement sign-off — target by May 16.

Stakeholders I captured from today:
- BrightPeak: Olivia Harper (Product Sponsor), Daniel Wu (Procurement; suggested), security lead TBD.
- Redwood: Michael Grant (AE), Monica Patel (Customer Success), Markus Klein (Sales Ops).

Immediate asks for you:
- Confirm the security contact (name + email) we should loop in for the compliance review.
- Confirm availability for a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive the week of Apr 12 (we have blocks on Apr 13 and Apr 14).
- Share any internal procurement timelines we should know about.

Attachments: redwood_mpa_v1.pdf — a draft outline of the alignment plan and milestone owners (not a contract).

If that looks right I’ll circulate a short updated plan with firm dates and include a preliminary cost estimate for the pilot.

Thanks — talk soon.
